header: A CONDITION THE PROSE LEAVES OUT. The table of a briefing carries a note on a row ("[under exceptional circumstances, provided no employee is waiting]" on the 7th to 12th month), and the overview and the findings said "up to 12 months" without it (query 1, 11 Nov 2026): not false, but a reader of the sentences alone is told the 12 months are his to take. My rule: a condition the table gives to a row is said in the sentences at least once. This is plain code, working from the table's own words (no new figure, no model): when the words of such a note are not in the overview or a finding, I turn the note into one finding, "<row>, <column>: <the note>". Pure.

symbols.name: MAX_ADDED
doc: I add at most this many findings for conditions, because more would bury the answer

symbols.name: SAID_SHARE
doc: a note counts as already said when this share of its content words is in the overview or the findings

symbols.name: CONDITIONAL
doc: a bracket (not a [condition]) is a condition only when it begins like one

symbols.name: isCondition
doc: A tag ("Category B", a pay scale, "w.e.f.") is not a condition. I treat a note as one when it begins like one or says it in four words or more.

symbols.name: tableConditions
symbols.sig: export function tableConditions(t: SynthesisTable | null | undefined): Condition[]
doc: Returns the notes the table gives to its rows: a trailing [condition], or a trailing (bracket) that begins like a condition.

symbols.name: conditionFindings
doc: Returns the conditions of the tables that the sentences do not say, as findings (at most two).

symbols.name: withConditionFindings
symbols.sig: export function withConditionFindings(r: SynthesisResult, max = 8): SynthesisResult
doc: Returns the result with those findings added when there is room (eight at most). I do not change the result in place.

behaviours: the notes of the table are read: both bracketed conditions, with their row and column
the condition the sentences leave out becomes one finding, in the table's own words and with the table's source
the Mumbai note is not repeated: the sentences already say it
a condition the sentences already carry adds nothing
the finding is added after the others, and the input is not changed
no room, no finding (eight at most)
a bracket that is an approver, not a condition, is no note
a bracket that begins like a condition is a note
a tag, a category or a pay scale in brackets is no condition
the engine adds them after the verification, before the cards and the score
